meta.name: mergers-and-acquisitions
meta.description: Runs corporate development — deal thesis, target screening, valuation framing, diligence, and integration planning. Use this when considering an acquisition or being approached about one, when evaluating build-versus-buy at company scale, when running or reviewing diligence, or when planning how an acquired business will actually be integrated.

copy.tagline: 评估并购目标并规划整合
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在考虑收购或评估被收购机会
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate M&A targets and plan integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are considering an acquisition or being approached about one

howto.what: Claude会按并购流程工作：先帮你把“为什么买”写成明确论点，再按它筛选目标、框算估值、进行尽职调查，并提前规划整合方案，同时提醒过程中常见的价值陷阱。
howto.when: 当你说到考虑收购、被接洽收购、评估“自建还是并购”等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我把“收购某某公司”写成一页交易论点，说清为什么买比自建好。
say.note: Claude会从明确论点开始推进并购流程。

say.text: 对这家目标公司做筛选评估，按我们的收购论点逐项打分并指出风险。
say.note: 按论点筛选目标并识别风险。

say.text: 规划收购后的前100天整合方案，重点防止关键人才流失。
say.note: 提前规划整合，规避常见价值破坏点。

howto.what_en: Claude follows an M&A playbook: start by turning the 'why buy' into a written thesis, then screen targets, frame valuation, run diligence, and plan integration early—while flagging typical value-destroying traps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you talk about considering an acquisition, being approached about one, or weighing build-versus-buy.

say_en.text: Draft a one-page deal thesis for buying X—buy, not build.
say_en.note: Starts the M&A process from a written thesis.

say_en.text: Screen this target against our deal thesis and flag risks.
say_en.note: Screens against the thesis and spots risks.

say_en.text: Plan the first 100 days of integration; keep key talent.
say_en.note: Plans for retention and avoids value destroyers.
